title: Ganday baddi qaxih gibbatu
intro: Atu isih gorrissam baddi qaxih caafatal, mooyat xongolo habbalteh tan ummattah tutuctot tangale. oson rabboh amri yeceen, takkay immay ken hirfeenit digaala fan beyte toh uxih edde yabtam tibba le xongolot. oson miyyak sugeenim atu baxxaqissam duuddaa?
clues: Nanu baddi qaxal mannowneeh, rabboh ayro nassakaxxuh amri neh yeceenih.
too ayro, kullumti nee fan yamaate mangoomuk, takkay immay nanu ken beynam waasneh sugne.
nek baali tatur qagitak takkaawisa, takkay immay gersi mari faxennal kullumta yabbixen.
Nanu diini amri diggosneeh, ninnil gibdi digaala baahenno.
Ni digaala milaaguk sugteeh, nee qaybi kee qaybi nee cabte.
Nanu damaaqe fanah korneh sugne, sarra yamaatu waa marah inkih asta.
arabic: وَسْـَٔلْهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ ٱلْبَحْرِ إِذْ يَعْدُونَ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًۭا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ ۙ لَا تَأْتِيهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَبْلُوهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient. (7:163)
